reddit.title: Improved Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share that we've made significant improvements to the music in Provincia! The day, night, title, and combat beds now feature a seamless transition thanks to a long equal-power self-crossfade. This means no more abrupt cuts in the audio, enhancing your gameplay experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Audio Improvements in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce enhancements to the audio experience in Provincia! The music now transitions smoothly between different states, eliminating hard cuts and providing a more immersive environment. For a detailed look at these changes, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
